name: ABB Controller
description: Connect to an ABB controller and expose a reusable, sticky-cached RWS session for the READ and mutation components. The session is reused across recomputes and rebuilt only when endpoint, version, or handle changes. The credential handle is a name, never a secret.

inputParameters.name: endpoint
inputParameters.description: Controller base URL. Unconnected defaults to http://127.0.0.1:80, the local RobotStudio virtual controller.

inputParameters.name: rw_version
inputParameters.description: RobotWare version, RW6 or RW7. Auto-creates a dropdown; defaults to RW6. Passed explicitly so RWS skips its blocking auto-detect probe.

inputParameters.name: credential_handle
inputParameters.description: Optional credential NAME (never a secret). Unconnected/blank uses the RobotStudio VC defaults; a named handle resolves ABB_<HANDLE>_USERNAME/PASSWORD from the environment at connect time.

outputParameters.name: controller
outputParameters.description: Reusable RWS session for the READ and mutation components. Sticky-cached per component and reused across solves; rebuilt only when the endpoint, version, or handle changes.

outputParameters.name: summary
outputParameters.description: Human-readable endpoint / rw_version / credential-handle-name line. Never contains a password.
